name: Timetable Generation & Optimization Engine
certification_marker: STAGE_9_PASS — TIMETABLE GENERATION & OPTIMIZATION ENGINE CERTIFIED

generation_architecture.event_domain_generation: Deterministic legal window enumeration respecting working hours, holidays, closures, and blocked time
generation_architecture.zero_domain_rule: Deterministic INFEASIBLE_GENERATION stop if any required movable event has 0 legal placements
generation_architecture.event_ordering: Most-Constrained-First heuristic with pinned/frozen priority, smallest domain size, shared events, labs, unique rooms, conflict degree, and stable event_id tie-breaker
generation_architecture.construction_engine: Incremental occupancy indexing across sections, faculty, and rooms with atomic placement of shared/multi-faculty events
generation_architecture.backtracking: Deterministic bounded backtracking search with recorded statistics and termination reasons
generation_architecture.lexicographic_optimization: Strict P0 (Hard Feasibility) -> P1 (Critical Soft) -> P2 (Runs & Gaps) -> P3 (Daily Load Balance) -> P4 (Lunch Quality) -> P5 (Preferences) -> P6 (Stability)
generation_architecture.storage_isolation: Immutable candidate generation directories under projects/generated/<generation_run_id>/

security.rbac_authorization: SUPER_ADMIN and TIMETABLE_ADMIN authorized; TEACHER authorized on owned projects; VIEWER strictly read-only
security.feasibility_freshness_gate: Enforced: Generation strictly blocked unless Stage 8.6 feasibility status is FEASIBLE or FEASIBLE_WITH_WARNINGS for exact project version and policy snapshot
security.audit_logging: Append-only events: GENERATION_STARTED, GENERATION_COMPLETED, GENERATION_FAILED, ACCESS_DENIED
